rationale: Identity was verified via full name and zip, matched to a single user ID using tools. The agent reviewed the user's orders and item details with read-only tools, correctly identified the delivered order containing the desk lamp and water bottle, and fetched available variants for each product. The agent clearly asked the user to confirm the exact replacement variants before proceeding; the user explicitly selected the 1000ml stainless steel (black) bottle and the silver, low-brightness, AC-adapter lamp. Only after that confirmation did the agent perform the exchange via the proper tool on the authenticated user’s order. The selected new item IDs and the original item IDs correctly match the user’s choices; the tool returned an exchange price difference of $6.46, which the agent reported accurately. Actions were taken on the correct account and order, and no unsupported claims or invented details were used. While the agent did not pre-announce the specific charge before submitting the exchange, the user had consented to the exact items and the final price difference reported matches the tool output. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
